title: Input Viewer
description: Adds a device that visually displays the current user inputs.
body:
This datapack adds an input tracker that displays which inputs the player is currently pressing. The input tracker can be crafted with an observer and 4 gold ingots:
![Crafting recipe for the Input Tracker: An observer surrounded by 4 gold ingots.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/5e8c21ace02a68a3cd3d91021057d6d67d1620de.png)

The red sections on the input tracker will light up depending on which inputs the player is pressing:
![Overview of input visuals](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/a0782debf6485a71f4f2fbc3c81075befb9282e4.png)

When held in the player's hand or offhand, the item will display directly facing the player for easier readability:
![View of the input tracker in the offhand.](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/8546f216f5fdcf2b788cbff1c4a50fdf1c3afb37.png)

This project was primarily created to show off user controls for my [Enchanted Elytra](https://modrinth.com/datapack/enchanted-elytra) datapack, but I figured I might as well share it here.
